title: Visualization library
description: Interactive explanations of mathematics and statistics.

visualizations.title: Rotations and column orthogonality
visualizations.description: See why rotating vectors preserves their angle, while mixing the columns of a matrix may change it.

visualizations.title: Principal vectors and angles
visualizations.description: Compare two planes, find their closest directions, and see why each principal vector projects along its partner.

visualizations.title: Successive best-aligned pairs
visualizations.description: Choose the closest pair of unit vectors, then watch the feasible directions shrink as orthogonality constraints are added.

visualizations.title: Metropolis–Hastings sampling
visualizations.description: Customize a target and proposal, adjust the proposal variance, and watch acceptance decisions build a Markov chain.

visualizations.title: Slice sampling
visualizations.description: Choose a height under the density, reveal the horizontal slice, and sample across all its intervals.
